chapters.title: Clocks, time zones and late data
Qualified numbers in Power BI and lineage

takeaways: A correct Power BI calculation does not prove that the underlying machine events are correct, so quality must be fixed upstream.
Data contracts, event identities, verified timestamps and explicit unknown states keep missing, duplicated or mis-scaled machine data from becoming false production numbers.
Publish confirmed and estimated output separately with their qualification and lineage, and start with a small pilot tied to one real production decision.
hook: Production reports can show precise numbers built on missed stops, duplicate counts and mislabeled units. This episode walks manufacturing data, OT and analytics teams through fixing machine data quality before it reaches Fabric and Power BI, so planners and supervisors can trust and explain the numbers they act on.
